An Overview of Blockchain Security Analy.title: An Overview of Blockchain Security Analysis

Context-I2W_ Mapping Images to Context-d.key_insight: 设计Intent View Selector和Visual Target Extractor两个互补模块，前者学习旋转规则选择视角，后者用可学习query提取局部目标信息。

Greenplum_ A Hybrid Database for Transac.title: Greenplum: A Hybrid Database for Transactional and Analytical Workloads
Greenplum_ A Hybrid Database for Transac.key_insight: Design decisions favoring OLAP workloads (two-phase commit, restrictive locking) become prohibitively expensive for OLTP — small overhead accumulates significantly for short queries
Greenplum_ A Hybrid Database for Transac.method_signature: Global Deadlock Detector + One-Phase Commit + Resource Groups for OLTP/OLAP isolation

Learning Deep Semantic Embeddings for Cr.title: Learning Deep Semantic Embeddings for Cross-Modal Retrieval

ProAPO_ Progressively Automatic Prompt O.title: ProAPO: Progressively Automatic Prompt Optimization for Visual Classification

ProAPO_ Progressively Automatic Prompt O.method_signature: ProAPO演化优化：edit操作(add/del/replace) + evolution操作(crossover/mutation) + entropy约束fitness score + 两级采样策略

SC-Tune_ Unleashing Self-Consistent Refe.title: SC-Tune: Unleashing Self-Consistent Referential Comprehension in Large Vision Language Models

SC-Tune_ Unleashing Self-Consistent Refe.method_signature: SC-Tune cyclical fine-tuning with PPO for describer and MLE for locator
